summary.intent: Run an overnight autonomous marathon (10:35 PM to 8 AM) to improve Cohezion's EVO (Exotic Vacuum Object) agent modeling pipeline, fix pre-existing test failures, and build compound engineering improvements using teams of specialist agents with TDD and V-model methodology.
summary.outcome: Built a complete EVO journey capture system (E1-E62 experiments), fixed 100+ pre-existing test failures across compound/FLUME/universe/cache/inference modules, created 10+ new compound analytics modules (SessionMetricsAggregator, ExperimentAnalytics, CompoundEngine, etc.), added 300+ new tests, and delivered the critical E57 additive calibration fix for Mycelium feedback compounding.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'], status at r['status'], primary metric at r['metric'] — NOT r['experiment'], r['verdict'], r['delta']
sentence_transformers is globally mocked in tests/conftest.py as MagicMock() to prevent AMD ROCm hardware segfaults — tests expecting real ST must use @pytest.mark.skipif(not _ST_IS_REAL)
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var bypasses the Kaggle-branch-guard pre-commit hook for legitimate production fixes on main branch
COHEZION_ALLOW_INSECURE_SURREAL=1 env var bypasses the SurrealDB credentials check required in integration tests
COHEZION_STRICT_AXIS=1 makes symmetry bridge unavailability raise RuntimeError instead of silently degrade
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets working tree to HEAD — untracked/modified files can be lost; use git checkout HEAD -- <file> to restore
autoresearch.jsonl had LFS pointer/content mismatch causing pre-commit stash failures; fixed by git rm --cached + .gitignore
Both psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent must be mocked in tests/compound/conftest.py — CPU at 99% on this machine blocks resource guardrails
SurrealDB probe must use RETURN true; not SELECT 1; (SurrealQL difference)
Pre-commit hooks run ruff-format + ruff-check + playwright + kaggle-guard; surgical git add of specific files needed to avoid cross-hook conflicts

code.finding: FlumeVAE.forward() returns 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z) consistently; dual-mode: FlumeVAE(config=FlumeVAEConfig(...)) for token transformer, FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) for legacy MLP; reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode

apply_mycelium_feedback() must use _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment (additive) not = assignment; SET semantics cause cycle 2 delta to decay rather than compound. _mycelium_calibration is cross-cycle stable, _score_adjustments is overwritten per-deliberation by run_llm_deliberation()

log_result() signature is (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str, **extra) — 6 positional args; E71-E76 initially had wrong 4-arg calls missing 'run' and 'status'
ExecutionResult.compound_score = coherence × (1 - 2|coherence-0.5|) × max(0, 1+skill_gain) — HIHO-balanced compound metric; field added as float=0.0 default
SessionMetricsAggregator.render_dashboard() provides human-readable compound session metrics; HIHO_THRESHOLD=0.5 classifies exploit vs explore mode

AxiomaticState.check_precipitation() implements Smith precipitation gate: HIHO threshold (coherence>0.5) + Shannon entropy H=-p*log2(p)-(1-p)*log2(1-p) + thermodynamic free energy F=E-TS; returns bool via explicit bool() cast since np.bool_ fails isinstance(x, bool)
set_lever_position() should be write-ahead (accept before validation); always returns success. _lever_overrides and _violation_logs added to __init__ for persistence

FlumeEncoder.encode() must raise ValueError when tokenizer returns no input_ids (not return silent zero-tensor sentinel) per CLAUDE.md anti-pattern rule. Root cause: conftest.py mocks transformers leaving PreTrainedTokenizer as MagicMock; fix was to expose real tokenizer in mock

download_dataset() returns bytes from REST API; download_dataset_path() returns Path via kagglehub. kagglehub.competition_download() is blocking synchronous — wrap with asyncio.to_thread() in async methods
WarmCacheLoader.load_cache() proxy method needed — tests expected it as thin wrapper to self._persistence.load_cache()
flush_all() must cancel pending _flush_batch task before executing to avoid 4 calls instead of 3 (concurrent flush race condition)

_MockVirtualMemory must have both percent=50.0 AND total/available GiB attributes; autouse fixture must patch BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent=25.0 or resource guardrails block execution on busy machines

workflow: Surgical git add pattern: ruff format + ruff check --fix manually first, then git add specific files (never git add -A), use KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 for kaggle files
Pre-commit stash conflicts: move conflicting runtime files (autoresearch.jsonl) out of tracked set via git rm --cached + .gitignore
AsyncMock vs MagicMock: async methods (httpx.AsyncClient.post, vault_write) MUST use AsyncMock; MagicMock.iterator exhaustion causes StopIteration→RuntimeError in async contexts

vault_write_sync pattern: check for running loop with asyncio.get_running_loop(); if no loop use asyncio.run(); if loop exists use loop.create_task(). Explicit coro.close() prevents 'coroutine never awaited' RuntimeWarning
Hardware-dependent test isolation: tests calling psutil/GPU/network singletons need explicit mocking or @pytest.mark.skipif guards — these fail under CI load as transient not deterministic failures
Test file naming: functions with test_ prefix are collected as tests by pytest even when imported as utilities; use aliases (from module import test_fn as check_fn)
V-model structural tests (~1ms each via inspect.signature()) catch API drift before behavioral tests; add to test_executor_vmodel_structural.py pattern
The convergence formula for Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = threshold - gap_0 × (1-lr/2)^n, max_error=0.00025 empirically validated
